correctness.rationale: For the stationary reset mobility, the generator sends w² to 2Λ²−αw² and w⁴ to 12Λ²w²−αw⁴. Thus E[D]=2Λ²/α and Var(D)=20Λ⁴/α²; the centered quadratic is an eigenfunction at −α, giving the stated exponential covariance. Conditional Gaussianity gives V=2E[H] and K=Var(H)/(E[H])² for H=∫D, and the conditional radial fourth moment is 4d(d+2)H². Integration yields K=10∫₀¹(1−u)exp(−zu)du, strictly decreasing with limits 5 and 0, so V and K identify both positive parameters at any known t>0. For disjoint windows the conditional increments are independent even for the same coordinate, so integrating the diffusivity covariance over the two windows gives the stated squared-increment covariance, including τ=h. The no-reset kernel follows by a Gaussian-in-w ansatz in Feynman–Kac; first-reset renewal gives the quotient with its denominator positive at s>0. Regenerative averaging of the integrated diffusivity gives the Gaussian limit. The bounded independent comparisons in /workspace/branches/frozen_math_replay.py (argument 5) passed; the uploaded script was inspected, not executed. The claim concerns ensemble moments, not measurement from one realized increment.
